svg.text: Cup (Fejér weights N = 23, amplitude per harmonic R/36, center 90°)
Waveform: f(ψ) = a R Σ (1 − m/(N+1)) cos m(ψ − θ), Σ over m = 1, 2, …, 23. a = 1/36, N = 23, θ = 90°
Drawn as: distance from the center r(ψ) = R + f(ψ); f(90°) = +0.3194 R, f(270°) = -0.0139 R
This waveform equals the sum of the even-only and the odd-only waveforms. At 270° the two cancel
